name: Otowa Youko
source: The third heroine of Natsu Kagura and the elder of the Otowa Clan. A Freeloader of Minamori shrine and a gentle person. She is very calm in any situation. Youko is actually an incarnation of nine tailed fox spectre. She was sealed by the great grandfather of Otowa, long time ago, and since then she had been serving at the Otowa home. Due to the nature of a fox, her smile is unexpectedly a part of her scheming. She has a bad habit of teasing other people, especially Keika, even during sex with her. In many ocassion, she demonstrated her great knowledges regarding the situatiion, including the youkai's detail. Youko seems to know Kijima from Oni Kagura series since long time ago. She has daughter named Nanaka, who appears at Debo no Subako. Youko appears at Aozora Magiccer which is direct sequel of Youko's route from Natsu Kagura and take place in alternate (fantasy) universe. Youko also makes cameo at Kagura Douchukii.
